description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_FineIssued</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_CarNotRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterNextServiceTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NextServiceRecorded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PreviousServiceSuccessful" name="Previous service successful"/>

      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check whether the car is still registered"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify the car owner"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TakeCarToService" name="Take the car to the service facility"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_ThirtyDays" name="30 days pass without going to service" attachedToRef="Task_TakeCarToService" cancelActivity="true">

        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueFine" name="Fine the car owner"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FineIssued" name="Car owner fined"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CarNotRegistered" name="Car is not registered"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCarProblems" name="Enter the car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit" name="Repair and send status updates"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdates" name="Send the car owner status updates by email while they wait"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin" name="Repair and status updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl" name="Enter that the repair was successful and the car received its Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" name="Enter the time for the next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NextServiceRecorded" name="Next service time recorded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToServiceNecessary" sourceRef="StartEvent_PreviousServiceSuccessful" targetRef="Event_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ServiceNecessaryToCheck" sourceRef="Event_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToRegisteredGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_CarRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisteredToNotify" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CarRegistered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">car_is_registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegisteredToEnd" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CarRegistered" targetRef="EndEvent_CarNotRegistered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not_car_is_registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToOwnerTask" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Task_TakeCarToService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OwnerTaskToEnterProblems" sourceRef="Task_TakeCarToService" targetRef="Task_EnterCarProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThirtyDaysToFine" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FineToEnd" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="EndEvent_FineIssued"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterProblemsToSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterCarProblems" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToStatusUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToRepair" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusUpdatesToJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairToJoin" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentToSuccessfulRepair" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SuccessfulRepairToNextService" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl" targetRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextServiceToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" targetRef="EndEvent_NextServiceRecorded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
